steps.name: Preranked GSEA on Hallmark gene sets
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB Hallmark pathways are enriched in the atopic dermatitis lesional (treated) vs control skin contrast, using the full ranked gene list from the existing DESeq2 results (de_results.csv, 12000 genes)?

grounding.reason: fgsea/gseapy preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark human sets is the default enrichment method for a DE results table (R-0107, R-0048); rank metric choice (Wald stat) stated per disputed rule R-0108; full ranked list per R-0045; size window 15-500 per R-0047

steps.description: Load de_results.csv, extract gene symbol and the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat/log2fc-derived per whatever column the table names as the test statistic; if only log2FoldChange and pvalue are present, compute a stated ranking statistic and document the substitution), drop genes with missing statistic, deduplicate gene symbols by keeping the entry with the largest absolute statistic, and rank the full list (no p-value or fold-change cutoff applied). Run gseapy.prerank against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets, HGNC symbols) staged at /mnt/refs/managed/msigdb-hallmark-human/2026.1/h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt, with min_size=15, max_size=500, permutation_num=1000, seed=42, weighted scoring. Output the full results table (NES, p-value, BH-adjusted q-value, leading-edge genes) sorted by q-value, and a plot of the top enriched Hallmark sets by NES.
acceptance_criteria: Ranked gene list covers all ~12000 tested genes with no significance-based pre-filtering
Rank metric used is explicitly stated in output (DESeq2 Wald statistic or documented substitute)
GSEA run against all 50 Hallmark sets with min_size=15/max_size=500 applied after intersecting with tested genes
Output table reports NES, nominal p-value, BH-adjusted q-value, and leading-edge gene list per Hallmark set
Seed and package version (gseapy) recorded for reproducibility

steps.name: Preranked GSEA on Reactome gene sets
steps.question: Which Reactome pathways are enriched in the same treated vs control ranked gene list, as a mechanistic follow-up to the Hallmark result?

grounding.reason: For human data, Reactome is the stated second enrichment collection after Hallmark (R-0098)

steps.description: Reuse the same ranked gene list built in T1S1 (same rank metric, same gene set) and run gseapy.prerank against the Reactome human pathway gene sets staged at /mnt/refs/managed/reactome-pathways/current/ReactomePathways.gmt, restricting to Homo sapiens entries using the accompanying ReactomePathways.txt index (join on stable ID to filter to species == 'Homo sapiens'). Apply the same min_size=15/max_size=500 window and seed=42. Output the full results table sorted by q-value.
acceptance_criteria: Reactome GMT filtered to Homo sapiens pathways only via ReactomePathways.txt join before running GSEA
Same rank metric and seed as T1S1 used for comparability
Output table reports NES, p-value, BH-adjusted q-value, and leading-edge genes per Reactome pathway
Reactome release/version noted in output (the 'current' snapshot is not pinned upstream, so record the file's staged date)

steps.name: Collapse redundant sets and report enrichment findings
steps.question: Which Hallmark and Reactome pathways represent distinct, non-redundant enriched biology in the atopic dermatitis lesional vs control contrast, and what are their leading-edge genes?

grounding.reason: Report step follows the knowledge-service reporting rules: collapse redundant sets, leading-edge listing, method-dependence caveat, and full reproducibility record

steps.description: Combine the Hallmark (T1S1) and Reactome (T1S2) GSEA result tables. Among sets significant at q<0.05, group sets whose leading-edge gene sets overlap substantially (e.g. Jaccard index above a stated threshold) and report one representative per group with its full leading-edge gene list, keeping the full uncollapsed table as a supplement. Produce a final report stating: the gene set database and version used for each collection, the rank metric (DESeq2 Wald statistic), the universe (tested genes only, ~12000), the size window (15-500), the number of genes that passed and failed identifier matching to each collection, the method-dependence caveat (GSEA is one of several enrichment approaches and results are hypotheses, not proven mechanisms), the reproducibility record (gseapy version, seed=42, gene set collection versions/dates), and a note that the DE results this analysis consumes originate from a dataset with a caveat (sample_01 library size ~4x below median) carried over from the upstream DE step.
acceptance_criteria: Redundant significant gene sets are grouped by leading-edge overlap with one representative reported per group
Full uncollapsed table retained as supplementary output
Report states gene set database names+versions, rank metric, universe, size window, and package/seed reproducibility record
Report explicitly notes enrichment-method dependence as a caveat, not as definitive biology
Report carries forward the sample_01 low-library-size caveat from the data context

plan.title: AD lesional vs control: Hallmark pathway GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The DESeq2 results table for the atopic dermatitis lesional (treated) vs control skin contrast (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch, 12000 genes) already exists at data/inputs/results/de_results.csv, so this plan starts from those results rather than re-running differential expression. Step 1 loads the DE table, validates gene identifiers and the presence of the DESeq2 Wald statistic column, builds a fully ranked gene list (no significance cutoff — per the knowledge-service rule R-0045/R-0107, thresholding before GSEA discards small coordinated set-level signal), and runs fgsea-style preranked GSEA (via gseapy.prerank) against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets, staged locally) with the Wald statistic as rank metric (rule R-0099/R-0108, stated choice), min/max set size 15/500 (R-0047), and a fixed seed for reproducibility (R-0086). Step 2 repeats the same preranked GSEA against Reactome pathway gene sets as the follow-up collection (R-0098), since Hallmark alone is coarse and Reactome resolves a hallmark hit to specific mechanisms. Step 3 collapses redundant significant Hallmark/Reactome sets that share most of their leading-edge genes (R-0052), reports leading-edge genes per significant set (R-0105), flags the sample_01 library-size caveat as a QC note carried from the DE step (it does not require re-analysis here since we are consuming existing DE results), and states the method-dependence caveat (R-0055) plus the full reproducibility record (gene set database + version, rank metric, universe, size window, package versions, seed).

steps.method: gseapy preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic (stat column of DESeq2 results) with MSigDB Hallmark gene sets
gseapy preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic with Reactome pathway gene sets
Enrichment report with leading edge genes, method dependence caveat, reproducibility record
